definition.method: Execute a Python script to compute variance across 20-step trajectories for coupled baseline sequences.
definition.source: def experiment(inputs): import random; params = inputs.get('parameters', {}); seeds = inputs.get('seeds', [222, 333, 444]); random.seed(seeds[0]); coupling = params.get('coupling', 0.90); baseline = [random.random() for _ in range(20)]; trajectory_a = [x * coupling + (random.random() * 0.05) for x in baseline]; trajectory_b = [x * coupling + (random.random() * 0.05) for x in baseline]; variance_delta = abs(sum(trajectory_a) - sum(trajectory_b)) / 20; return {'measurements':{'divergence_variance_delta':[variance_delta]}}
